responsibility: Customizes GCC machine modes for the AVR target, especially the nonstandard integer and fixed-point widths that the backend depends on. It introduces the 24-bit `PSI` fractional-integer mode and overrides the size, alignment, and integer/fractional bit layout of the `TA` and `UTA` accum modes so that AVR uses 64-bit representations instead of impractical 128-bit ones, with corresponding special handling expected in the AVR backend and runtime support.
